releaseNotes:
• Soft Keyboard Auto-Lift: window smoothly glides upward when typing so input field is never covered, and auto-restores when keyboard closes
• Unread Notification Red Dot: floating bubble shows a vibrant red dot badge when web apps receive notifications or messages
• Real Brand Icons: bundled official icons for 50+ Web Apps even if not installed
• Drag-to-Dismiss: drag floating bubble to bottom-center cross (✕) to close app instantly
